configurations.// web: Starts the dev server. autoPort is deliberately false: Next 16 detects a duplicate `next dev` by DIRECTORY, not by port, so a second instance dies instantly no matter what port it lands on. Failing loudly here is correct — if it says 'already running', use the `attached` config below instead of retrying.
configurations.name: web

configurations.// attached: No command — attaches to a dev server that is already running (started by `npm run dev` or by the user). Use this whenever `web` reports a duplicate instead of spawning a competing server.
configurations.name: attached
